docs.title: About CRC Cyber Hawks
docs.text: Detect • Defend • Dominate. We are the official student-led cybersecurity organization at Cosumnes River College, dedicated to building practical, hands-on offensive and defensive security skills outside the classroom.

docs.title: Our Background & Mission
docs.text: Founded to bridge the gap between textbook theory and real-world security operations, the CRC Cyber Hawks prepare students for regional and national collegiate competitions, industry certifications, and cybersecurity careers. No prior experience is required—we train members from their first Linux command all the way to live incident response.

docs.title: What We Focus On
docs.text:
• Defensive Operations (Blue Team): Hardening Linux and Windows servers, analyzing network traffic, and responding to simulated live cyberattacks in collegiate defense competitions.
  • Capture The Flag (CTF): Solving timed challenges in cryptography, web exploitation, digital forensics, and OSINT.
  • Career & Skill Building: Resume reviews, home lab walkthroughs, and certification study groups (Security+, Network+, CySA+).

docs.title: Student Resources & Toolkit
docs.text: Bookmark this page for direct links to the software, virtual machines, and training platforms we use during meetings and competitions.

docs.title: Essential Software Downloads
docs.text:
• Virtualization (VirtualBox / VMware)

    Run isolated Linux and Windows lab environments safely on your personal laptop.

    Download VirtualBox

  • Kali Linux & Ubuntu

    Standard penetration testing and defensive server ISOs for lab exercises and CTFs.

    Get Kali Linux

  • Wireshark

    Industry-standard network protocol analyzer for inspecting PCAP files and live traffic.

    Download Wireshark

  • Sysinternals Suite & CyberChef

    Essential Windows endpoint monitoring tools and browser-based data decoding/analysis.

    Open CyberChef

docs.title: Free Practice Platforms
docs.text:
• TryHackMe: Guided, beginner-friendly rooms for Linux, networking, and SOC fundamentals.
  • OverTheWire (Bandit): The best command-line wargame to learn Linux terminal navigation.
  • PicoCTF: Year-round beginner-to-intermediate CTF challenges with great learning guides.
